slides.alt: Two halves of a pumpkin with seeds on a wooden board. Text: There's something funny about pumpkins.
Close-up of the seeds and fibres inside a pumpkin half. Text: First, they laugh in your face with their funny "teeth".
Baking tray with sliced pumpkin, sage, red onion and aubergine on baking paper. Text: They never cease to smile, even when I bake them on an oven tray.
Two flatbread doughs topped with pumpkin slices, sage and anchovies, before baking. Text: Or when they end up on a pizza.
A white casserole dish full of roasted pumpkin and chickpeas on a kitchen counter. Text: They look cheerful even diced in a casserole.
